f3_program: collection("adam.school.classes", "class", "adam.school", source("80 students in three classes"))
partition("adam.school.classes", at("adam.school.students.count", "current"), source("The rest are in class C"))
percent_of(at("adam.school.classes.a.students.count", "current"), at("adam.school.students.count", "current"), 40, source("40% of the students are in class A"))
offset(at("adam.school.classes.b.students.count", "current"), at("adam.school.classes.a.students.count", "current"), -21, "count", source("class B has 21 students fewer than class A"))

partition("louise.pencil_color_groups", at("louise.pencils.count", "current"), source("20 red pencils, twice as many blue pencils, 40 yellow pencils, and has as many green pencils as she has red and blue pencils combined"))
multiple(at("louise.pencils.blue.count", "current"), at("louise.pencils.red.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many blue pencils"))

sum_relation(at("louise.pencils.green.count", "current"), at("louise.pencils.red.count", "current"), at("louise.pencils.blue.count", "current"), source("as many green pencils as she has red and blue pencils combined"))
assumptions: Treated the listed colors as the complete pencil-color partition.

f3_program: add("purchase", "kate", at("kate.magic_wands.count", "current"), 3, source("Kate buys 3 magic wands"))
collection("kate.magic_wand_allocations", "magic_wand_group", "kate.magic_wands", source("one for herself and two for her friends"))
partition("kate.magic_wand_allocations", event_field("purchase", "quantity"), source("one for herself and two for her friends"))
transfer("sale", "kate", "kate.magic_wands", "kate.friends.magic_wands", at("kate.magic_wands.for_friends.count", "after_purchase"), source("she sells the wands to her friends"))
offset(at("kate.magic_wand.unit_sale_price", "sale"), at("kate.magic_wand.unit_purchase_price", "purchase"), 5, "currency", source("$5 more than she paid"))
assumptions: Resolved the wands sold to her friends as the two wands allocated to them.
Interpreted the $5 comparison and requested cost as per-wand prices.

f3_program: older_than(at("mark.age", "now"), at("amy.age", "now"), 7, "year", source("Mark is 7 years older than Amy"))
collection("james.fish_tank_fish_counts", "fish_count", "james.fish_tanks", source("1 of the tanks has 20 fish in it and the other two have twice as many fish each as the first"))
member("james.fish_tank_fish_counts", "james.fish_tanks.first.fish.count", source("1 of the tanks has 20 fish in it"))
observe(at("james.fish_tanks.first.fish.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("1 of the tanks has 20 fish in it"))
multiple(at("james.fish_tanks.other_1.fish.count", "current"), at("james.fish_tanks.first.fish.count", "current"), 2, source("the other two have twice as many fish each as the first"))
multiple(at("james.fish_tanks.other_2.fish.count", "current"), at("james.fish_tanks.first.fish.count", "current"), 2, source("the other two have twice as many fish each as the first"))
assumptions: Represented the two otherwise unnamed tanks as other_1 and other_2.
